cohort: 210 pregnant women undergoing labour induction with 0.5 mg Dinoprostone gel intracervically.
finding: Intracervical Dinoprostone gel induction resulted in 83.80% vaginal deliveries with mean induction-to-delivery intervals of 13.6 hours for primigravida and 8.9 hours for multigravida, and low rates of maternal complications (7.61%) and NICU admissions (0.9%).
mod_finding: Intracervical Dinoprostone gel application was associated with a high successful vaginal delivery rate of 83.80%.
